'''Glovstoak's palace''' was located in a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] [[Governor/Legends|ruled]] by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Glovstoak]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. It contained the Moff's [[Glovstoak's quarters|quarters]] and [[ballroom]], where Glovstoak held parties.<ref name="Allegiance" />
